description: Registry of evaluated-but-not-promoted decision engine levers. Prevents re-running dead ends and indexes governance artifacts.

levers.name: catalyst_tilt
levers.summary: Multiplicative weight tilt by catalyst proximity band (NEAR=1.10, MID=1.05, FAR=0.95, MISSING=0.90). Default mults show correct signal direction but insufficient magnitude and too few NEAR names to justify turnover.

metrics.notes: Catalyst strength signal confirmed (near +5.56%, mid +4.50% >> far -0.15%, missing -0.63%). Tilt mults need recalibration once catalyst coverage improves.

revisit_conditions: When 2025+ archives have >50% NEAR+MID catalyst coverage (currently ~28%)
After recalibrating tilt multipliers via sweep (current defaults are placeholder)

levers.name: dd_rel_margin_rescue
levers.summary: Override drawdown exclusion when relative margin is close to the gate (sector-driven drawdown). Threshold=-0.05 too aggressive: dilutes A-tier and spikes turnover in 2025.

metrics.notes: Full panel (2024+2025) shows +1.24pp sep, but 2025-only shows -2.05pp. Rescued cohort mean +21.21% (2025) but dilutes A from +18.17% to +16.55%.

revisit_conditions: After testing tighter threshold (-0.02) or composite condition (rel_margin > -0.02 AND catalyst_mode != 'missing')
When more 2025+ history available to confirm rescued cohort performance stability

levers.name: catalyst_window_365d
levers.summary: Widen pipeline catalyst detection window from 180d to 365d. Improves DQ gate pass rate (33/33 vs 24/33) but dilutes 2025 tier separation (+0.97pp to +0.30pp). Wider window floods A/B tiers with far-out catalysts.

metrics.notes: Solved by catalyst_strength bands instead (NEAR/MID/FAR). Wider window captured in pipeline but FAR catalysts gated from A-tier.

revisit_conditions: No revisit planned — superseded by catalyst_strength band gating

levers.name: soft_drawdown_mode
levers.summary: Replace hard drawdown gate with soft (size-penalty) mode. Policy matrix showed soft drawdown dilutes alpha and worsens P5 from -29% to -38%.

metrics.notes: v1.3_candidate (8452265a) rejected. Hard+AND mode (require_both) is strictly better.

revisit_conditions: No revisit planned — hard+AND mode with relative gate is superior

levers.name: trial_active_backfill
levers.summary: Backfill historical archives with trial_active status from ClinicalTrials.gov to improve catalyst coverage in 2024. Would fix structural catalyst sparsity (78.9% missing in 2024) but requires external API integration and PIT-safety audit.

metrics.notes: 2024 catalyst regime is fundamentally broken (pipeline didn't capture catalyst_decay before mid-2024). Backfill would fix data coverage but calibration sweep still shows 0/40 configs pass on 2024+2025 combined.

revisit_conditions: When ClinicalTrials.gov API integration is built for live pipeline
After confirming PIT-safety of retrospective trial_active imputation

levers.name: sec_8k_enrichment
levers.summary: Enrich archives with SEC 8-K filing data as catalyst proxy (FDA approvals, trial results). Would provide PIT-safe catalyst signal independent of pipeline's catalyst_decay field.

metrics.notes: SEC EDGAR API integration needed. secadcom trial showed modest improvement in catalyst coverage but no change in tier separation dynamics. Requires substantial engineering effort for marginal gain.

revisit_conditions: When SEC EDGAR API is integrated into live pipeline
After building reliable 8-K event classifier (approval vs. routine filing)
